title: Find the spec, progress and proof easily
objective: Navigate between the spec, current progress and evidence without wading through internal details.

suggestedSlices.title: Navigate work and inspect its proof
acceptance: Open the selected spec and its evidence from a focused overview, with three main navigation choices and reachable secondary pages on keyboard and narrow screens.
Switch between evidence, history and process without losing deep links or browser history; preserve permission, evidence freshness and explicit test execution.
